Resolution: reverted payments-api-config ratelimit.max_rps to 5000 via ArgoCD (by Rahul Verma, TTR 22 min). What did NOT work: scaled payments-api out 2x to absorb the 'surge' (limit is per-merchant config; more pods, same 429s). Action items: Link this incident to its family runbook; Add a regression alert.

title: upi-gateway long GC pauses and latency
logs: 2026-10-18T04:54:04.012Z WARN upi-gateway-277cec115-dffck [GC (Allocation Failure) Full GC pause 4211ms] heap 96%
2026-10-18T04:54:39.644Z WARN upi-gateway-277cec115-dffck npci-client queued=1000/1000 active=200/200
2026-10-18T04:54:36.758Z ERROR upi-gateway-277cec115-dffck NPCI ReqPay timeout after 30000ms payer_psp=SBI ifsc=SBIN0000001
2026-10-18T04:54:47.637Z ERROR upi-gateway-277cec115-dffck java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException: Task rejected from npci-client executor

precedingChange.description: upi-gateway deploy: logging library bump
precedingChange.author: Vikram Nair

timeline.msg: 🚨 [SEV2] JVMGCPauseHigh — upi-gateway GC pause 4.2s, heap 96%
ack. on it
seeing WARN upi-gateway-277cec115-dffck npci-client queued=1000/1000 active=200/200
trying: increased upi-gateway heap from 4G to 8G
no luck — queue kept growing; GC pauses returned
trying: rolled back logging library bump
no luck — no change
paging @Rahul, they've handled this before
joining. checking the last change that went out
the heap is full of queued SBI ReqPay calls — bank timeout again
applying: opened npci-sbi circuit breaker, failed SBI over to NPCI-DC2, timeout 30s → 8s
metrics back to baseline, resolving. will write up the PM

rootCause: SBI switch degraded at NPCI; 30s ReqPay timeouts filled the npci-client queue with in-flight requests, which drove heap to 96% and long GC pauses. GC was a symptom of the external bank timeout, not a memory leak.
fixThatWorked: opened npci-sbi circuit breaker, failed SBI over to NPCI-DC2, timeout 30s → 8s
postMortem: Impact: ~70k UPI txns slow/failed, SBI heaviest. Trigger: upi-gateway deploy: logging library bump (commit 63a37ee by Vikram Nair). Root cause: SBI switch degraded at NPCI; 30s ReqPay timeouts filled the npci-client queue with in-flight requests, which drove heap to 96% and long GC pauses. GC was a symptom of the external bank timeout, not a memory leak. Resolution: opened npci-sbi circuit breaker, failed SBI over to NPCI-DC2, timeout 30s → 8s (by Rahul Verma, TTR 52 min). What did NOT work: increased upi-gateway heap from 4G to 8G (queue kept growing; GC pauses returned); rolled back logging library bump (no change). Action items: Link this incident to its family runbook; Add a regression alert.

Resolution: reverted max.poll.records to 500 and enabled static membership (by Sneha Kulkarni, TTR 46 min). What did NOT work: switched to backup SMS provider (provider was not the bottleneck). Action items: Link this incident to its family runbook; Add a regression alert.
